_README: Tracked mutant manifest for scripts/mutate.py. Closes SR-12's F17-R.
Every entry must be re-derivable by a stranger: `find` is matched EXACTLY ONCE or the RUN fails
(not the mutant -- see trap 3 in scripts/mutate.py), and `killers` are resolved through the real
unittest loader before anything is mutated (trap 2).
A KILLED result here is evidence. A SURVIVED_UNCONFIRMED result is not a finding: only --full,
which asserts that NOTHING in the suite catches the mutant, can support a survival claim.
Adding a mutant is cheap and is the point. Removing one silently is how this project lost 265

CLASS-U MUTANTS (`U-` prefix) target the four modules whose marks rested on mutation sweeps nobody can re-run -- schema.py (SR-04), robustness.py (SR-11), claim_ledger.py (SR-13/14), dashboard.py (SR-13). Their killers are EXISTING tests, derived by applying each mutant and seeing what failed, not written for this manifest. That is deliberate: it re-derives a slice of those marks' own evidence, which is what F17-R asked for and what the first 15 mutants did NOT do.
